title: U.S. Rescues Missing Air Force Officer Whose Fighter Jet Was Downed by Iran
partialText: An Air Force officer of a F-15E Strike Eagle shot down on Friday by Iran spent a day in hostile territory with little more than a pistol for protection.

title: How the CIA Helped Locate a Missing Airman After Iran Downed a U.S. Fighter Jet
partialText: The intelligence agency also executed a deception campaign aimed at drawing Iranian forces away from where the missing Air Force officer was hiding.

title: Trump Seems Emboldened With New Threats in Truth Social Post Over Strait of Hormuz
partialText: In an expletive-filled social media post, Mr. Trump said Iran should open the Strait of Hormuz or he will bomb bridges and power plants.

title: Stephen Miller Is Still Pursuing His Immigration Agenda, but More Quietly
partialText: The architect of President Trump’s mass deportation campaign wants “a moratorium on immigration from third world countries until we can heal ourselves as a nation.” The chaos in Minneapolis has not pushed him off that course.

title: ICE Arrests in Texas Leave Children to Raise Their Siblings After Parents Are Detained
partialText: Andrea García and her siblings are carrying on in a home reshaped by fear, loss and new responsibility.

title: Judge Pauses Trump Demand for Student Race Data in 17 States
partialText: The Trump administration had said it would collect data from colleges to ensure compliance with a Supreme Court ruling ending affirmative action in admissions.

title: China Built the World’s Drone Industry. Now It’s Locking Down the Skies.
partialText: The Chinese government tightened rules to curb what it described as illegal drone use, but some users say the changes are now restricting too many flights.

title: What Were Bob Dylan and John Lennon Really Saying in the Back of That Limo?
partialText: A film scene of Dylan and Lennon at a low moment in 1966 has held a grim fascination for fans. Beneath the repartee, a touchy issue was at stake.

title: Want to Change? Maybe Stop Trying So Hard.
partialText: The self-transformation industry sells control. Real change is messier.

title: Easter Reminds Us That Resurrection Is Everywhere
partialText: Marriages, careers, reputations, financial stability and dreams can all die. But that’s not the end of the story.

title: Is Christianity Making a Comeback?
partialText: Some see Easter Sunday’s packed pews and overflowing chapels as a sign of a religious revival. But experts are urging caution.

title: Dozens Killed in Haiti Massacre as International Force Trickles In
partialText: Gangs tore through several rural communities last weekend, underscoring the challenges that will face the new, U.N.-backed Gang Suppression Force starting to enter the country.

title: Pope Leo Calls for Peace and Warns of a World Indifferent to Violence
partialText: The pontiff’s Easter remarks follow a Palm Sunday homily in which he said God rejected the prayers of “those who wage war.”

title: Uber and Trial Lawyers Spar Over New Yorkers’ Auto Insurance Premiums
partialText: A powerful lawyers’ association is opposing a bill that would cap damages, but the ride-share company has spent millions lobbying state lawmakers to lower rates, some of the highest in the country.

title: After 53 Years, This Beach Town’s Fight to Secede Is Over. Kind Of.
partialText: South Seaside Park on the Jersey Shore has just succeeded in leaving Berkeley Township and joining its neighbor, Seaside Park, but there are still more challenges ahead.
